title: The Pale Machine
premise: Ivo Almeida, a clone who inherited both her original's memories and the unsolved murder that killed her, tends a lonely beacon at the edge of dead space. When a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, she discovers the beacon was built to catch exactly this transmission — and the murdered original knew it. Racing the fading signal to an abandoned relay, Ivo uncovers a massacre covered up by the corporation that made her, and finds her original's killer still alive among the survivors. In the end she must choose between the justice the law will never deliver and becoming the pale machine they designed her to be; she broadcasts the truth instead of the bullet, and lets the dead speak for themselves.
about_author: Zephyrine Galloway is the pen name of a former radio astronomer who spent three years maintaining remote listening stations in the southern ocean before turning to fiction. She writes slow-burning science fiction about isolation, inherited guilt, and the voices we build machines to remember.

chapters.title: The Beacon Nobody Ordered
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Alone on the beacon station, Ivo maintains equipment whose maintenance logs predate her activation and whose commissioning records were scrubbed. Through fragmented inherited memories — including flashes of her original's murder — she senses the beacon is waiting for something. When the impossible signal arrives in a dead language, her grief and curiosity fuse into purpose. Emotional beat: loneliness cracking open into dread.

chapters.title: A Language for the Drowned
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV, with interludes from the signal itself. Decoding the distress call, Ivo realizes it names the colony ship Callisto's Wake — destroyed two centuries ago, officially by accident. Her original's memories sharpen: the beacon was built as a trap for this truth. She strips the station, launches for the relay at the edge of dead space as corporate salvage ships begin converging. Emotional beat: inheritance becoming obligation.

chapters.title: Dead Space, Living Ghosts
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. At the relay, Ivo finds survivors' descendants in cryo-stasis and the man who killed her original — now old, repentant, keeper of the full record of the massacre. He explains why the original died: she chose silence over exposure. Salvage teams breach the relay hunting the signal. Ivo holds the archive in her hands and the killer at her mercy. Emotional beat: rage meeting its limit.

chapters.title: What the Machine Remembers
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Cornered in the relay's transmitter core, Ivo faces the choice her original couldn't make: kill the man, or broadcast everything and let institutions do their slow failing work. She transmits the massacre record wideband, waking the sleepers and burning her own corporate leash. The killer surrenders to the awakened colonists' judgment, not hers. Ivo returns to the beacon no longer alone. Emotional beat: grief transmuted into witness.
